endorsements.quote: Importantly, AI should be viewed as an adjunct to, not a replacement for, clinical judgment.
The next generation of AI tools should prioritize transparency, interpretability, and meaningful clinical impact rather than incremental gains in statistical performance.

unlisted_practices: Conduct prospective validation studies demonstrating real-world effectiveness of AI tools in hypertension care.
Integrate AI tools into existing clinical workflows without increasing complexity.

screen.reason: This is an editorial discussing the implementation, governance, and safeguarding priorities (such as implementation science, transparency, and equity) for AI in hypertension care.
